notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark without duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags cannot be selected to filter bookmarks.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, and tags, but not notes or the full URL path.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed and a query such as #design does not match the stored tag.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, grouping, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not interpreted as exact phrase searches.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting the entire currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: The Archive control is inert and bookmarks have no archived state.
REF-BM-27: Reversible archiving is absent, so it cannot be distinguished behaviorally from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: The Archive control does not open or filter an archived-bookmark list.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is inert and no display preferences can be adjusted.
